title: Schedule list appears empty after login to cloud despite having data
description: When logging into the Luxor Cloud, the schedule list is displayed as empty, even though there is existing data for schedules.
steps: Enter email and password in the respective fields.
Observe the 'Connecting to Luxor Cloud' loading indicator.
Tap the 'GO TO MY SITES' button.
Observe the 'Processing your request' loading indicator.
actual: After logging into Luxor Cloud and navigating through the site list, the schedule list appears empty. The '+ CREATE SCHEDULE' button is visible, but no existing schedules are displayed.
expected: After logging into Luxor Cloud and navigating through the site list, the schedule list should display all existing schedules.
